claim: A playlist holds 1 to 20 tracks the editor can reorder
Each track has a title, an artist, an uploaded audio file and optional artwork
Only uploaded files are accepted, not web addresses
An optional transcript opens under a Transcript heading
Chapters have a label and start time and show as buttons such as Sermon (08:40)
Audio does not load until the visitor presses play
Tracks do not play on from one to the next
Starting one track pauses the other
Tapping a chapter jumps the track there and plays it
